title: Streamflow Stats for the USGS Stream Gage Cheery Creek at Denver - USGS Station ID: 06713500
abstract: This data contains detailed information about the basin characteristics and streamflow characteristics for the US stream gage Cheery Creek at Denver, Colorado (station ID: 06713500). All data in this resource has been obtained from USGS Streamstats.
